summary.text: Brad Fritts is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 74th District, serving since January 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Fritts's legislature biography says Fritts was born and raised in Dixon, earned a degree in agricultural and consumer economics from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and works on the family farm in Dixon.
